ILOAD

00110100 100000000 00 0101 // H = LV
00111001 100000000 00 0000 // H = H+1
00111000 000000001 01 0000 // MAR = H; rd
00110101 000001000 00 0100 // SP = SP+1
00110100 000000001 10 0100 //MAR = SP; wr
00110100 001000000 00 0000 //TOS = MDR

00110101 000001000 00 0100 //SP = SP+1
00110100 000000001 00 0100 //MAR =SP 
00110100 000000010 10 0111 // MDR = TOS , wr
